Meanwhile, Light to Moderate with occasionally Heavy rains are expected over #OccidentalMindoro(Sablayan, Calintaan, Rizal, SanJose, Magsaysay), #Palawan(Araceli, Dumaran, SanVicente, Roxas, PuertoPrincesaCity, Aborlan, Narra), #Aklan(Malay, Buruanga, Nabas, Ibajay, Tangalan), #Antique(Pandan, Libertad, Sebaste, Culasi, Tibiao, Barbaza, LauaAn, Bugasong, Belison, Patnongon), #Iloilo(Igbaras, Guimbal, Tigbauan, Pavia, Oton, SanMiguel, Tubungan, Alimodian, Leon, Maasin, Cabatuan, SantaBarbara, Leganes, NewLucena, Zarraga, Dumangas, BarotacNuevo, Pototan, Mina, Badiangan, Janiuay, Dingle, Anilao, BarotacViejo, Lambunao, Calinog, Bingawan, CityOfPassi, Dueñas, SanEnrique, SanRafael, Banate), #Capiz(Dumarao, Cuartero, Dumalag, Jamindan, Tapaz), #NegrosOccidental(Pontevedra, LaCastellana), #NegrosOriental(CanlaonCity and Vallehermoso) within the next 30 minutes to an hour.

The above conditions are being experienced in #OccidentalMindoro(AbraDeIlog, Mamburao, SantaCruz), #Palawan(Coron, Busuanga, Culion, ElNido, Taytay, Linapacan, Magsaysay, Cuyo, Agutaya), #Antique(SanJose, Sibalom, SanRemigio, Valderrama), #Iloilo(Miagao, IloiloCity, Carles, Balasan, Estancia, Batad, SanDionisio, Sara, Lemery, Concepcion, Ajuy), #Aklan(Makato, Numancia, Lezo, Malinao, Madalag, Libacao, Balete, Kalibo, Banga, NewWashington, Batan, Altavas), #Capiz(Mambusao, SapiAn, Ivisan, RoxasCity, Panay, Sigma, Panitan, MaAyon, Dao, Pontevedra, PresidentRoxas, Pilar), #NegrosOccidental(SanEnrique, LaCarlotaCity, SanCarlosCity, Murcia, SalvadorBenedicto, Calatrava, SilayCity, EnriqueB.Magalona, CityOfVictorias, Manapla, CadizCity, SagayCity, CityOfEscalante and Toboso) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 11:00 PM Today.
